# QS-CFW-1466-55 - Quality specification - bearing ring CFW-1466-55 (52100)

Revision: Rev C  
Supersedes: Rev B  
Plant: P2  
Parts: CFW-1466-55

Scope
- This document defines the minimum quality requirements, inspection acceptance criteria, and nonconformance handling for bearing ring CFW-1466-55 manufactured at Plant P2 from material 52100.

Requirements table
| Feature | Requirement | Acceptance |
|---|---:|---|
| Material | 52100 (per purchase order and material certificate) | Certificate required |
| Hardness (through thickness) | 36-41 HRC. | Measured value must fall within 36-41 HRC. |
| Bore diameter tolerance | ±0.03 mm. | Measured bore must be within nominal ±0.03 mm. |
| Maximum forging weight | 27.4 kg. | Forging weight must not exceed 27.4 kg. |
| Surface condition | Free of cracks, laps, and forge-scale inclusions that affect fit/function | Visual/ND inspection per method below |

Inspection method
- Sampling: Inspect each lot per lot inspection plan. Record all measured values on the lot inspection record.
- Hardness: Use Rockwell hardness tester calibrated to ISO/ASTM laboratory standards. Report hardness in HRC and record location of each reading. Verify measured value against 36-41 HRC.
- Bore diameter: Measure bore diameter using calibrated bore gauge or CMM. Report deviation and confirm within ±0.03 mm.
- Weight: Weigh forgings with calibrated scale; confirm weight does not exceed 27.4 kg.
- Surface: Perform visual inspection at 5–10× magnification or NDT as required. Reject parts with discontinuities that affect form, fit, or function.

Nonconformance handling
- Any part or lot failing to meet the hardness, bore tolerance, maximum forging weight, or surface criteria is nonconforming.
- Segregate nonconforming material and label with NCR status. Document all nonconformances on an NCR form and include measured values and inspection evidence.
- Disposition options: rework, scrap, or return to supplier. Rework must restore compliance to the specified requirements in this document and be authorized by Quality. Reworked parts require 100% reinspection for the failed parameter(s).
- Escalate repeat occurrences or systemic issues to Plant Quality for containment and corrective action.
